summary.headline: Sample shop API: two serious access-control gaps and no CI gate; the data layer is otherwise sound.
summary.grade_note: Rule used: any Critical finding means D or F. One Critical, contained by Wave 0.

top_risks.text: Any signed-in user can read another customer's orders by changing the ID in the URL.
Deploys run from any branch with no tests required.

do_this_week: Add the ownership check to the order endpoints (SEC-001).
Make the test job required before deploy (OPS-001).

fix_first.reason: Active exposure; small fix; unblocks the authorization test suite.
Cheap, and every later fix depends on a working gate.

scorecard.why: Object-level access control missing on orders.
No required checks; images use latest tags.
Good unit tests; no authorization tests.

findings.title: Orders can be read by any signed-in user
findings.evidence: GET /orders/:id loads the order by ID only. A second user's token returns 200 with the first user's order (traced; reproduced on a local copy).
findings.impact_text: Customer addresses and purchases are readable by other customers.
findings.root_cause: Handlers load by ID and never compare the owner to the caller.
findings.fix: Scope the query by the caller's user ID in the service; return 404 for other owners.
findings.test: HTTP test: user B requesting user A's order gets 404.

findings.title: Deploy job runs without required tests
findings.urgency_reason: Blocks safe delivery of every other fix.
findings.evidence: The deploy step has no dependency on the test job, and any branch can trigger it.
findings.fix: Make deploy depend on the test job and restrict it to the main branch.
findings.test: Open a PR with a failing test; the pipeline must refuse to deploy.

findings.title: No role-by-route authorization test
findings.urgency_reason: Medium severity; prevents regressions of SEC-001.
findings.evidence: No test file exercises routes with more than one user role.
findings.fix: Add a table-driven test: every route times every role, asserting allowed or forbidden.
findings.test: The matrix test itself, run in CI.

chains.title: Order data exposure goes unnoticed
steps: Attacker signs up as a normal user.
Changes the order ID in requests (SEC-001).
No audit log or alert records the access.

waves.name: Stop the exposure
waves.goal: Close the order data exposure and make the pipeline trustworthy.
exit_criteria: A user cannot read another user's order (test).
Deploy requires a green test job.
waves.why_order: SEC-001 is actively exploitable. OPS-001 is cheap and every later change relies on it.

waves.name: Lock it in
waves.goal: Prevent regressions with an authorization matrix.
exit_criteria: Matrix test runs in CI and fails if a route loses its guard.
waves.why_order: It needs both W0 fixes to exist first.

strengths.title: Small, pure scoring functions
strengths.detail: Business rules are isolated and well tested.

skipped.reason: Out of scope for this run

coverage.gaps: Production configuration was not available; findings about deployed settings are not verified.
